text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Sheffy walked down the highway alone, bathed in the gentle sunlight. Her steps were light. Until just a moment ago...
text_block_list.orig_text:
穏やかな日差しを浴びながら、一人街道をゆくシェフィ。
その足取りは、軽かった。
つい先ほどまでは……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Umm... The map is... ah, that's not it. This is a New Year's osechi recipe. It's an important thing that Ruka-san wrote for me, so I shouldn't lose it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと……
地図は……
違うわね。
これは、
おせちのレシピだったわ。
ルカさんが書いてくれた大切なものだから
無くさないように……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: As for the map. Let's see... There it is, as for Oma... Here, on the map!
text_block_list.orig_text:
地図は、
あった。
ええと……
あった、
オーマが地図のここだから……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I've come along this way, haven't I? I'm definitely sure that I'm on this highway, but... Where, exactly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こう進んできた、
はず……
よね？
街道沿いなのは確かなんだけど……
ここって、
どこかしら？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Six shadows watched Sheffy from behind...
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなシェフィの姿を、後方からうかがう影が６つ……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: For some reason, she’s stopped in the middle of the road... Come to think of it, can Sheffy even read a map?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか、
道の真ん中で立ち止まっちゃってるけど……
そういえば、
シェフィって地図は読めたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I don't think she's ever been alone by herself to need a map to navigate... This is probably her first time doing this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
地図が必要な場所には一人で行ったことはないかもしれません……
この辺りは初めて来る場所でしょうし。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's lost! I'll teach her how to look at a map right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
迷子になってしまったのかもしれません！
わたくしが
今から地図の見方をしっかり教えて差し上げます……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait right there! Not now, endure it, Korosuke!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ちなさい！
今はダメよ、
耐えなさいコロ助！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's right. Everyone here decided to watch over her, so let's do that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ。
みんなで見守るって
決めたじゃあないか。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The six who were supposed to have parted ways in the town of Oma have not returned to Landosol. It was Pecorine's plan to sneakily follow Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーマの町で別れたはずの６人はランドソルに帰ってはいない。
シェフィの後をこっそりとついていくのは、ペコリーヌの作戦だった。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We've trusted in Sheffy and asked her to go shopping, so now we'll do our best to watch over her as we hide!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィちゃんを信頼して買い出しをお願いして
わたしたちは隠れて頑張る姿を見守る！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: "Operation New Year's Memories" has now been changed to "Operation Sheffy-chan's Errand"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『【美食殿】
思い出おせち作戦』改め
『シェフィちゃんのおつかい大作戦』です！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Well, it's probably a plan a little too contrived on some details, but it's still a fine idea. The experience of being relied on will help her develop a sense of independence more than anything else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
少々わざとらしかったが
よい作戦ではないか。
頼られる経験は
なによりも自立心を育てるからのう。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: And that's exactly why, Kokkoro-chan... you have to hold back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからコッコロちゃん、
ここは我慢ですよ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes, Lady Pecorine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
ペコリーヌさま。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That said, at this rate, I wonder if she'll actually get lost...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
このままだと道に迷って
どこに行ってしまうやら……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu, if things continue as they are, she won't be able to complete her errand?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ、
おつかいとやらも果たせぬぞ？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH! I can't take it anymore! I... I'm going to go give her some advice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー！　
もう我慢できません！
わたし、
アドバイスしにいってきます！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey! Respect the words that you just spouted a second ago!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こら！　
あんたさっきと言ってることが違うじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: It's okay. As long as she doesn't find out it's me, it'll be allright. So, using this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ですよ。
わたしたちだとバレなければいいんです。
だからこれで……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Hmm... This is a problem. I wish I could find out where I am on this map now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
困ったわね。
今いる場所が
この地図のどこなのか分かればいいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Heheheheh. What seems to be the matter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぉっふぉっふぉ。
どうなされましたかな？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: What about you...?
text_block_list.orig_text: あなたは……？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I'm just an old man passing by. If there's something bothering you, why don't you talk to me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
通りすがりの老人ですじゃよ。
困ってることがあるなら
話してみてはくださらんかのう？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That DUMBORINE! With such a cheap disguise, of course she'd find out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんのアホリーヌ！
そんなのバレるに決まってるじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: No, please wait, Lady Kyaru.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
お待ちください、
キャルさま。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Umm, well... I suppose that I am a little lost.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと、
ちょっと道が分からなくなっちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Looks like she wasn't found out...
text_block_list.orig_text: バレとらんようじゃの……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Somehow... that seems to be the case...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう
みたいだね……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Isn't that crazy☆ Ah no, I mean, let me see that map.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはやばいですね☆　
じゃなくてですのう。
どれ、
その地図を見せてみなされ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Do you know where we are now in the map?
text_block_list.orig_text: 今の位置がどこか分かりますか？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We're right here. Hohoho.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここですじゃぞ。
ほっほっほ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ah... So this path will lead to my destination... Understood, thank you very much. ...Um, perhaps, have we met before?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
じゃあこの道を進んだところが目的地なのね……
分かりました、
ありがとうございます。
……あの、
もしかして
どこかでお会いしたことありますか？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: A-Aren't you just imagining things?! You're probably thinking that because you're alone. If you're feeling lonely, I'll guide you to your destination.
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
気のせいじゃないですかのう！
そんなことを思うのは
一人でいるからではないですかな。
心細いようなら
その目的地まで案内してしんぜよう。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No, your feelings are enough. Thank you very much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
お気持ちだけで十分です。
ありがとうございました。

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then, please be careful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですか。
それではお気をつけてゆくんですぞ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Whew... How did I do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
どうでした？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: She certainly doesn't seem to have noticed, but... Just looking at that scene made me uneasy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに気づいちゃいないようだが……
見てて不安になっちまうよ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Sheffy is a very honest person... I guess she thinks there's no way we could be here, even in disguise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさまは素直なお方ですので……
わたくしたちがここにいるはずがないと思われているのでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Somehow, that makes me feel even more guilty... I'm worried she might be easily deceived...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか
罪悪感がすごいわね……
だまされたりしないか心配だわ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Still, it'd have been very dangerous if she got lost. I guess we were right to watch over her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
道に迷っておったのは危なかったのう。
わらわたちが見守っておって
正解じゃったということか……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ah! She's moving! Let's keep track and follow her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
移動します！
わたしたちもついていきますよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Umm, it seems the vegetables I need are in this village, huh. There are so many varieties I've never seen in Landosol... Excuse me, could I have this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと、
この村ではお野菜、
ね。
ランドソルじゃ見たことない種類がこんなに……
すみません、
これもらえますか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Doesn't it sound like things are going well?
text_block_list.orig_text: 順調そうじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text: そうですね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Ah, ah... You mustn't, Lady Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
あっ……
いけませんシェフィさま。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Korosuke?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしたのよコロ助。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: If she tries to put things in her bag so hapharzardly, it'll...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのように無理に入れようとすると
袋が……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ah! The bag's torn. The vegetables I bought with great care are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
袋破れちゃった。
せっかく買ったお野菜が……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: I... I'll be going now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたくし、
行ってまいります！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Korosuke!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、
コロ助！？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure to handle this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫でございます。
わたくしはこれを……！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Oh my, oh my, your vegetables have fallen. Allow me to help you pick them up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おやおや、
お野菜が。
拾うのを手伝わせてくださいまし。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Um, you're...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
あなたは……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Merely an old woman that's passing by. Come on, let's hurry up and pick them up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
通りすがりの
老婆にございますよ。
さあさあ、
早く拾ってしまいましょう。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...She didn't find out again.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……バレてないわね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Kokkoro-chan, I'm impressed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コッコロちゃん、
さすがです！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's all of them. Please use this instead of your torn bag.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
これで全部でございますね。
破れた袋の代わりに
こちらをお使いください。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, for everything I've caused. At least let me give you something as thanks...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません、
なにからなにまで。
せめて、
何かお礼を……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: No, no, that's fine. More importantly, isn't your luggage heavy? If you don't mind, I can help you carry it to your next destination...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ、
結構でございますよ。
それよりも、
荷物は重くはないですか？
よければ
次の目的地まで持つのをお手伝いいたしますが……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I couldn't let you go that far for me. This is something very important that my friends asked me to do. So it'll never be heavy for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこまでしてもらうわけにはいきません。
これは、
仲間から頼まれた
大事な物なんです。
だから、
重くなんてありません。

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Very admirable words, Lady Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご立派でございます、
シェフィさま。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? My name... did I tell you what it was? If not then... perhaps, you're someone I know...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
名前、
教えましたっけ？
もしかして
私のことを知ってる人じゃあ……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: No, no! Um, I just saw the name on this torn bag and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ！　
あの、
こちらの破れた袋に
お名前が……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's true. I didn't notice. Kokkoro-san must've written it on for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当だ、
気が付かなかったわ。
コッコロさんが書いてくれてたのね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This bag... I wonder if she had prepared it for me back when I was still acting like a baby? And yet here I am, tearing it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この袋……
私が赤ちゃんみたいになっちゃっていたときに
用意してくれたものなのかしら？
それなのに私ったら、
破っちゃうなんて……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: If that's what you're worrying about, I can fix it. So do not worry about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その程度でしたら、
繕えば直ります。
気になさることはありませんよ。

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: In fact, I'm sure that whoever made it would be happier that you've used it to your heart's content.
text_block_list.orig_text:
むしろ
破れるくらいまでしっかりと使ってもらえるほうが
作った者にはうれしいものでございます。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...I sure hope so. I'll take good care of this bag and bring it back home with me. So, um, I guess I should thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだったらいいな。
この袋は
大切に持ち帰ります。
それであの、
やっぱりお礼を……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: N-No, I'm fine, really. Well then, please be careful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いえ。
大丈夫でございますよ？
それでは
お気を付けて……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: You too, granny! Thank you very much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お婆さんも！
ありがとうございました！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That sure was close...
text_block_list.orig_text: 危なかったわね……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: My deepest apologies. I was moved by Lady Sheffy's words...
text_block_list.orig_text:
申し訳ありません、
シェフィさまのお言葉に
感動してしまいました……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Honestly, it's so scary to just keep watch like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
見ててヒヤヒヤするったらないよ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's right. When her bag got torn, I was wondering what'd happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
袋が破れた時は
どうなるかと思いました。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Actually, I was talking about what you two just did...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシが言ってるのは
アンタたちのことなんだけどねえ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Looks like she's back on track already. Let's go after her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先へ進むようじゃぞ。
わらわたちも追うとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With a note in hand, Sheffy headed towards a group of carriages parked along the highway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィはメモを片手に、街道沿いに止まっている
馬車の一団へと向かっていた。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Umm, it should be around here... I wonder if that's it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと、
この辺りに……
あれかしら。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Is this where the caravan shop is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん。
キャラバンのお店って
ここであってますか？

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. Welcome to the Caravan Store, where you can find anything from Landosol down to Centuria, and even rarities from Togoku itself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そうだよ。
ランドソルから獣人の国、
果てはトーゴクの品まで、
なんでも揃う
キャラバンの店へようこそ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Um, there's something I'd like you to sell me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
売ってもらいたいものがあるのだけど。

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: It's the end of the year. People really love to go out and buy stuff at this time of year, so... If you're wearing a furisode, are you looking for something from Togoku?
text_block_list.orig_text:
年の瀬のこの時期だ。
パーッと買っていってもらいたいのはやまやまなんだが……
晴れ着を着てるってことは、
トーゴクの品をご所望かい？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm looking for ingredients for a New Year's osechi, they're mentioned in this note...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
このメモにある
おせちの材料なんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's bad timing. I happened to go out of stock just a moment ago. There's a customer who bought everything we had.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
間が悪いねえ。
それはさっき
在庫切れになっちまったよ。
ウチにある分を全部買っていった客がいてねえ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way... Are there perhaps any other shops that sell those things? My friends are looking forward to it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
そんな……
他にどこかで売ってる店はないかしら？
仲間が楽しみに待ってるの……

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I don't think you can get those things anywhere else around here. Sorry, but I suppose you'll just have to be reasonable and give up here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
ここいらじゃあウチ以外だと手に入らないと思うよ？
悪いが諦めてもらうしか……

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: Everything got bought up... by that creepy guy from earlier?
text_block_list.orig_text:
買い占めって、
さっきのガラの悪い男かい？

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Oh my, if it isn't the customer who was just done buying things a second ago? Do you still need something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
あんたはさっき買い物してくれたお客さんじゃないか。
まだ何か入用かい？

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: I just happened to overhear you talking. Is this high-grade soy sauce from Togoku what you're looking for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと話し声が聞こえてね。
欲しいものってのは
このトーゴクの高級醤油ってやつかい？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's it! But, why are you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それです！
でも
どうしてあなたが……

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: I bought it before that guy bought them all up. Take this with you, if you like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの男に買い占められる前に買ってたのさ。
良かったらコレ、
持って行きな。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: But, I'd feel bad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
悪いわ……

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: It's fine. I just happened to buy it because I found it unusual. Your friends are waiting for you to bring this back home, aren't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのよ。
あたしは物珍しいから買っただけだしさ。
あんたは
仲間が待ってるんだろう？

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're lucky, young lady. You should accept her generosity.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
嬢ちゃんついてるねえ。
遠慮せずにもらっときなよ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. But I can't take it for free. Let me find some way to thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます。
でも、
ただでもらうわけにはいかないわ。
お礼はさせてもらうから……

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: I told you already, it's fine. What's with you? You're pretty stubborn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいって言ってるだろう。
なんだい、
随分と強情な子だねえ。

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Then, how about this... The customer will return the item, and the young lady will buy it again. Then there should be no problem at all, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあこうしたらどうだい、
お客さんは
それを返品して、
それを改めて
嬢ちゃんが買い取る。
それなら問題ないだろ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's certainly true, but... Are you sure?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かにそうだけど……
本当に
いいの？

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's fine, it's fine. Well then, I'll return it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハハッ、
いいよいいよ。
それじゃあ、
返品しておくれ。

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: Okay. Well then, young lady, it's yours now. Take it to your friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいよ。
それじゃ嬢ちゃん、
これで晴れてあんたのもんだ。
仲間のとこに
持ってってやんな。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much. I don't know how to thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に、
ありがとう。
なんてお礼を言えばいいか……

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: It's no big deal. I just want to do something good at the end of the year and start the new year in a good mood.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんてことないさ。
年の瀬にちょっとだけいいことして、
いい気分で新しい年を迎えたいだけだよ。

text_block_list.name: Aunt
text_block_list.text: If you really want to thank me, then... yeah. Try to share the same gesture with someone else in the future. That's how the world should work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしお礼がしたいってんなら……
そうさね。
誰かに同じようにしてあげな。
世間てのは
そうやって回ってるんだからねえ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: All right. I'll do that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかったわ。
そうしてみます。

text_block_list.name: Caravan Salesman
text_block_list.text: That's a good spirit to have. Well then, young lady, have a good year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうこった。
それじゃあ嬢ちゃん、
よいお年を。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Have a good year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
よいお年を。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: In this case, there was no need for us to even intervene.
text_block_list.orig_text: 私たちが出る幕なかったですね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is because of Lady Sheffy's prime virtue that people around her lean in to help like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
このように周りが助けてくれるのは
シェフィさまの人徳ゆえでございます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep. Geez, you two are being so soft on her. Even so, a remote store like this one being sold out at a time like this... I wonder if it's grown popular?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい。
まったくあんたたちは甘いんだから。
それにしても、
こんなところでも買い占めって……
流行ってるのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: There are people everywhere who don't care about the trouble they cause others, it seems.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人様の迷惑を顧みない連中ってのは
どこにでもいるもんさね。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Honestly, it's deplorable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
嘆かわしいのう。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Illya, you should be the last one to share that comment here.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……イリヤがそれを言っちゃうのね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Sheffy's journey continued smoothly, but suddenly she was stuck along the highway with many others.
text_block_list.orig_text:
順調に進むシェフィの旅だったが、街道の途中で
多くの人々とともに立ち往生してしまう。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, did something happen?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません、
何かあったんですか？

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: The bridge ahead is impassable... Apparently it was attacked and nearly destroyed by a large monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この先の橋が通れなくなってるんだよ……
なんでも
大きな魔物に落とされたらしいんだ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's a problem... That must be why so many people are standing there because they can't cross the river.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変……
それじゃ
川を渡れなくて
こんなに人が立ち止まってるのね。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: The bridge hasn't completely collapsed, so it looks like we can cross the remaining part... but it's way too thin, so we'll have to be very light to be able to cross. And you see... we've all bought loads of supplies for the New Year's.
text_block_list.orig_text:
橋は完全に落ちたわけじゃあないから
残った部分を渡れそうなんだが……
細すぎて身軽じゃないと無理だよ。
年越し用にいろいろと買い込んだ後だからねえ。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Even if we were to take a detour here, the other bridges are simply too far away... The things we buy are perishable, so if we leave them like this they might end up going bad. That's what's bothering everyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遠回りしようにも
他の橋は遠いし……
買ってるのは生ものだから、
このままじゃあ傷んじまう。
それでみんな困ってるのさ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Oh no, that sounds like quite the blunder. How about it? Wanna hear me out and go along with my plan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
そいつは大変じゃねえか。
どうだい？　
俺の話に乗ってみないか？

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Who are you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ？　
あんたは……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm just a passing merchant. But I'm feeling a bit chivalrous right about now. So, how about it? I'll buy all that baggage from you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやあ、
俺は通りすがりの商人さ。
だが、
ちょっと義侠心が湧いてきてね。
どうだい？　
あんたのその荷物、
買い取ってやろうじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: どういうことだ？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: If you were empty-handed you could cross the bridge, right? The only way for you to get home quickly is to throw away all that luggage. That's the only way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
手ぶらなら渡れるんだろう？
早く帰るには荷物を捨てるしかない。
でもそれじゃああんまりだ。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Well, that's true. I won't be able to make it back for the new year's otherwise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃあそうだな。
年が越せなくなっちまう。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Therefore, instead of simply throwing it away, wouldn't it be better to sell it to someone and have some money return from it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこで、
だ。
捨てるくらいなら誰かに売って、
金を回収しておいた方がマシだろう？

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: I see. That makes sense. So you're the one that's going to buy all of this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど。
確かにそうだ。
それじゃあ、
あんたが買い取ってくれるのかい？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. That said, I don't really have that much capital on me. I thought I'd be out to buy just New Year's lucky charms, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああそうさ。
とはいえ
俺もそんなに元手があるわけじゃあない。
正月の縁起物限定で
買い取らせてもらおうと思ってね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Certainly, that does sound like a good idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
いい案に思えるわね。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Well then, I guess I'll sell all of it. I have this and this, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
売っちまうか。
俺が持ってるのはこれとこれなんだが……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll buy it all. That said, with this and that, well, it's only going to be 5,000 rupees at most.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいぜ。
買い取ろう。
とはいえ、
コレだとまあせいぜいが5000ルピってところかねえ。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're going to be that cheap? I bought all of this for 50,000 rupees, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ？　
そんなに安いのかい？
これだけでも
50000ルピで買ったんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: You say that, but I'm being fairly charitable here myself. If you don't like it, why don't you just leave it somewhere and cross the river with 0 rupees?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうはいってもねえ。
こっちもほぼほぼ慈善事業なわけよ。
嫌ならそこらに捨てて
０ルピで川を渡るかい？

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う
っ……
それは……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Young lady over there, you've got some luggage of your own too. How about it? I'll buy it all for you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこのお嬢ちゃんも結構な量の荷物があるじゃないか。
どうだい？　
買い取ってやるぜ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, actually...
text_block_list.orig_text: 私はいいわ……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: No, I'm saying you should show me what you have... Wh-What? You've got quite a few rare items here. Hey, hey, you should sell them. Here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
ちょっと見せてみろって……
な、
なんだぁ？　
ずいぶんなレア物そろえてるじゃねえか。
なあなあ、
売ったほうがいいって。
ほら。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I cannot. Those are all important items that my friends asked me to gather for them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメよ。
これは仲間に頼まれた大切なものだから。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: But it's better than letting them rot here, right? Hey, hey...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもこのままここで腐らせるよりはマシだろう？
なあなあ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: WAIT JUST A MINUTE...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと待ったぁ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだ？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: What's with that attitude?! This isn't charity, this is merely an extortion!
text_block_list.orig_text:
黙って聞いてりゃ
何よその態度！
慈善事業とか言いながら
ほぼ恐喝じゃない。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: What did you just say?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだとぉ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Um, you're...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと、
あなたは……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What is it?! Don’t stare at me like that! I’m not dressed like this because I want to! What’s with those guys? Seriously... Wait, that's beside the point now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……な、
なによ！　
じろじろ見ないでよ！
あたしだって好きでこんな格好してるんじゃないわよ！
なんなのよほんと……
って、
それはいいから！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: I'm just a passing by... passerby! It's not really important who I am right now! But more importantly, look at this guy! Doesn't he seem a bit suspicious?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただの通りすがりの……
通りすがりよ！
今はそんなこといいでしょ！　
それよりこいつよ！
なんか怪しくない？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Wha... What the hell are you going on about? Don't make any false accusations!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なに言ってやがるんだ。
言いがかりも大概にしろや！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: I should be the one wondering what you're doing! You're bargaining as hard as you can! And you're lying in wait here like this. It's almost like you knew the bridge was going to fall.
text_block_list.orig_text:
思いっきり買い叩いてるくせに何言ってんのよ！
それに
こんなところで待ち伏せみたいにさ。
まるで
橋が落ちるのが分かってたみたいじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: H-HUH...? Why are you saying that?! This is just slander! Unfounded accusations!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はあ？　
何を根拠にそんなこといってやがる！
言いがかりだ、
言いがかり！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: What did you just say?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんですってぇ！？

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Calm down, both of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どっちも落ち着きなよ、
なあ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: You might see it as slander, but... I don't think it's right to take advantage of someone's weaknesses.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに
言いがかりかもしれないけど……
で
も、
弱みに付け込むようなことは、
良くないと思うわ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Advantage or not... that's simply business!
text_block_list.orig_text: 良くないも何も商売ってのはそういうもんなんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I don't think so. At the very least, the people I met earlier were different. I think it's important to communicate your feelings, not just your money.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
違うと思う。
少なくとも、
私がさっき出会った人たちは違ったわ。
お金だけじゃなくて、
気持ちをやり取りするのが大切なんだと思う。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Wha...
text_block_list.orig_text: なっ……

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it... you're right. Rather than selling it for next to nothing like this, it would be better to just eat it here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに……
そうだなあ。
こんな二束三文で売り払うくらいなら、
ここで食べてしまった方がマシか……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: That's right. If you're going to be such a cheapskate about it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね。
そんなに安く買い叩かれるくらいなら……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, hey. Wait just a minute. Hey, reconsider... JUST SELL IT ALL TO ME! I HAVE THE MONEY, I SAID!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おいおい。
待てよ。
なあ、
考えなおせって……
いいから全部売れよ！
金ならあるんだからよ！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: No, actually... I finally remember. That irritating way of speaking and your face! Hey, you... weren't you back at the temple and Oma both?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っていうか……
やっと思い出したわ。
そのムカつく言い方と顔！
ねえ、
あんたさあ……
神殿と、
オーマにもいなかった？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Wh-What? How'd you even know that... Wait, no, no. I've no idea what you're talking about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ、
なに？　
なんでそれを……
ってかいやいやいや。
知らねえなあ？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Really? You were trying to buy up all the good luck charms at Oma but the fishermen chased you away, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？
オーマで縁起物買い占めようとして
漁師に追い返されてたでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: I-I-I don't know about that. There's about fifty people in Landosol alone who happen to look just like me, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ししし、
知らねえよ。
俺に似たやつなんてランドソルには50人はいると思うぜ？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Well, it's certainly true that you happen to have a common looking face. But you were there after all, weren't you? You were there, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
確かにありがちな顔してるけどさ。
やっぱりいたでしょ？
いたわよね？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: I-I told you, I don't know! Damn it! Who gives a shit about you guys?! Just throw those worthless items on the side of the road, you idiots!
text_block_list.orig_text:
し、
知らねえって言ってるだろ！
くそ！　
お前らなんか知るか！
道端にでも捨ててろ、
バーカ！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: What's that?! Gonna run away?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なによ！　
逃げるっての？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Shut up! You idiot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせえ！　
バーカバーカ！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: AAAAH, GEEZ! You're pissing me off!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーもう！　
ムカつくわね！！！

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: He's gone, huh? Well, whatever. Sure, those things are perishable, but I guess we can just eat them here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
行っちまったか。
まあいいや。
よし、
生だけど
そのままここで食っちまおう……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Looks like I'll have to take the long way around too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も、
遠回りするしかなさそうね……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you giving up already? If it's you... it's nothing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ？　
なんで諦めるのよ。
あんたなら……
なんでもないわ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I mean, you can see by yourself that the bridge's collapsed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって
橋は崩れているっていうし……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Think carefully about what you can do. You must be good at something, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分に何ができるか
よく思い出してみなさい。
得意なものとか
あるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...That’s right, my ice magic! Why didn’t I think of it? I might be able to do something about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだ、
魔法！　
なんで思いつかなかったんだろう。
私なら、
なんとかできるかもしれないわ。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: What kind of "something"?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんとかって？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Maybe I could use the wreckage of the bridge for my idea. Stay away for a bit. Haaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
橋の残骸を使えばいけそうね。
ちょっと離れてて。
はあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's that? An ice bridge suddenly formed... Did you do this, girl?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだあ？
氷の橋がかかって……
これ、
あんたがやったのかい？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. I don't think it'll melt easily, but please cross as soon as you can.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
簡単には溶けないと思うけど、
できるだけ早く渡ってね。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: You're a lifesaver! Now I can go home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
助かるよ！
これで家に帰れる！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Really! Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと！　
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait a minute. You said that your packages contain perishable items...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ちょっと待って。
あなたの荷物、
生ものなのよね。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Aahh yeah, could I share some with you as thanks? What do you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
そうだ、
お礼にもらってくれないか？
どうだい？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'll just take your kind words. I have my own baggage to deal with. Um... I was thinking of using my ice magic on your perishable items to make them last longer, actually. Is that okay with you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちだけ、
いただくわ。
私には自分の荷物があるもの。
えっと……
生ものにも氷の魔法をかけてあげると
長持ちすると思うのだけど。
いいかしら？

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... Are you sure? Wow, that's amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……
いいのかい？
おおっ、
すごい。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I think this will be fine. If there are other people who live far away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで大丈夫だと思うわ。
他にも
家が遠い人がいたら……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Well then, can I ask you to do the same?
text_block_list.orig_text: それじゃ私もお願いしてもいいかしら？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Of course.
text_block_list.orig_text: もちろんよ。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I think I'll be able to have a good year's end. I really don't know how to thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
君のおかげで
いい年末を送れそうだ。
本当に
なんて礼を言ったらいいか……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: You don't have to... thank me. ...But if you'd really want to, then do the same for someone else. That's how the world works, apparently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お礼なんて……
いいわ。
……でも、
よかったら
誰かに同じようによくしてあげて。
世間というのは
そうやって回ってるものらしいから。

text_block_list.name: Uncle
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're right. I'll do that. Thank you. Have a good year!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
そうだな。
そうするよ。
ありがとう。
いいお年を！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: I do, thank you
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Oh my? Come to think of it, that feisty person with the glasses just now... I forgot to thank her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
あれ、
そういえばさっきの人は……
お礼、
言いそびれちゃったな。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I believe I've seen her somewhere before. She also seemed to know about my magic...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこかで見たことあるのよね。
私の魔法のことを知っていたみたいだったし……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Phew... Looks like things worked out somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
なんとかなったわね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Well done, Lady Kyaru.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お見事でした、
キャルさま。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: In the end, all I did was chase that thug away. More importantly, it seems that she really didn't find out once again... It gives me complicated feelings to know this disguise served some use...
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局あたしは
あいつを追い払っただけだけどね。
それより
ほんとにバレてなかったっぽいわね……
こんな変装が役に立ったってのがほんと複雑……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Still, Sheffy truly was amazing back there. She used her power and abilities not only for her own ends, but for everyone around her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
たいしたもんじゃないか、
シェフィ。
自分だけじゃなくて
周りのために
自分の能力を使いこなしてさ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hasn't that girl grown more reliable than you all would've imagined?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主らが思っておる以上に
しっかりとしておるではないか？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's right. Our Sheffy truly is considerate of other's feelings! She's really one of a kind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
他の人たちのこともちゃんと考えてて、
シェフィちゃんってば
すごく立派ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: I didn't know she was that strong-willed.
text_block_list.orig_text: あそこまで芯の強い方だったのですね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Maybe by spoiling her so much, Korosuke and the others never took notice of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロ助たちが甘やかしすぎて、
気づいてなかったのかも……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I feel somewhat responsible...
text_block_list.orig_text: 反省です……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Next time, let's not take action so easily, but trust in Sheffy and keep a close watch on her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
次からは安易に手を出さずに、
シェフィさまを信じて
しっかりと見守りましょう。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: We have to believe in Sheffy, huh...? Yeah, that's all for Sheffy's sake, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィを信じて、
か……
そうね、
それがシェフィのためかもしれないわ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes! I believe in her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！　
信じますよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Aside from that, I'm bewildered by the actions of that shady guy. He's definitely the one who tried to buy up all the items in Oma. It seems like you're good at remembering people's faces, Kyaru.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
あの男にもよく気付いたものよ。
確かに
オーマにおった買い占め未遂犯じゃな。
どうやらキャルは
人の顔を覚えるのが得意なようじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's not really the case here. It's just that I can't forget the faces of people who piss me off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別にそんなことないわよ。
ただ、
あたしのことムカつかせたやつの顔は忘れないだけだから。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, that's a reassuring way of living. However, it seems like he's up to something. I'll also be careful next time I see him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっは、
そりゃ頼もしいねえ。
とはいえ、
アイツはなにか企んでそうだ。
次見かけたときは
よく注意しておこうかね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The group was moved by Sheffy's visible and steadfast growth, but also held a twinge of unease in their hearts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィの成長に感動しながらも、
一抹の不安を胸に抱える一行であった。
